# Bee SDK 6.0.0 (vendored, unmodified)

Acki Nacki's Bee Engine SDK, copied byte-for-byte from the npm package `@teamgosh/bee-sdk@6.0.0`
(npm shasum `9ecc561ae9b7145a859f730e4cc32221f5918dd8`). Source: https://github.com/gosh-sh/bee-engine
Licence: AGPL-3.0 (see LICENSE.md and NOTICE.md, from that repository). GOSH confirmed bundling and
self-hosting `bee_sdk_bg.wasm` in TalonHive Hub is fine.

To update: download the new version, check its shasum against `npm view @teamgosh/bee-sdk@<v> dist.shasum`,
put it in a new `bee-sdk-<v>/` folder and change the path in `www/bee.js`.
